items.summary: Reported BBN memo changes capped active transmit and receive links at 63 each and discarded a new-link message when the transmit table was full.
Should unused entries expire after 26 seconds or only when the transmit table is full? The memo records the exchange.
A measurement message could be discarded at the destination IMP without reaching its host. The notes also correct a type number from octal 10 to decimal 8.
The notes point to RFC 22 for changes to the work described in RFC 11 and mention a forthcoming revision.
Publish the follow-up on transmitting multiple control messages.
